outgoing.name: Automobile
outgoing.excerpt: Major industries include food processing, lumber, automobile manufacturing, and the manufacture of textiles, chemicals, and soap.

outgoing.name: Bridge
outgoing.excerpt: It stands in Ébrié Lagoon on several converging peninsulas and islands, connected by bridges.

outgoing.name: France
outgoing.excerpt: The city grew after the construction of a new wharf in 1931 and its designation as the capital of the then French colony in 1933.

outgoing.name: Oil refinery
outgoing.excerpt: There is also a large oil refinery.

outgoing.name: Park
outgoing.excerpt: On the other hand, Abidjan is referred to as the "Paris of West Africa" because of its parks, broad boulevards, universities, exotic fashions and museums.

outgoing.name: Rainforest
outgoing.excerpt: Sights in Abidjan include St Paul's Cathedral, designed by Aldo Spiritom, the Cocody Municipal Museum of Contemporary Art and the Parc du Banco rainforest reserve.

outgoing.name: Train
outgoing.excerpt: Trains on the line to Ouagadougou run from several stations in the city, the most important being in Treichville.
